objectives.label: Ime mu je Enzo. Star je pet mesecev.
objectives.descriptorEN: Say what the puppy's name is and how old he is.

objectives.label: Ne, prijazen je. / Še mladiček je, živahen je.
objectives.descriptorEN: Answer «A grize?» — reassure her, or warn her he's lively.

objectives.label: Oprostite! / Nič hudega, prijazen je.
objectives.descriptorEN: Respond when he jumps up at someone: apologise, or calmly reassure.

objectives.label: Počasi, prosim. / Ponovite, prosim. / Ne razumem.
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask her to slow down, to repeat, or say you don't understand.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan. Kako je luštkan! Kako mu je ime?
n1.en: Good day. Oh, how cute he is! What's his name?
n1.deliverySL: [warmly] Dober dan. Kako je luštkan! Kako mu je ime?

c1.speaker: client
c1.sl: Dober dan, hvala. Ime mu je Enzo.
c1.en: Good day, thanks. His name is Enzo.
c1.deliverySL: [warmly] Dober dan, hvala. Ime mu je Enzo.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Enzo, lepo ime. Koliko je star?
n3.en: Enzo, a lovely name. How old is he?
n3.deliverySL: [warmly] Enzo, lepo ime. Koliko je star?

c4b.speaker: client
c4b.en: He's still a puppy, he's lively.

n5a.speaker: npc
n5a.sl: Pridi sem, pridi! Je fant ali punca?
n5a.en: Come here, come on! Is he a boy or a girl?
n5a.deliverySL: [warmly] Pridi sem, pridi! Je fant ali punca?

n5b.speaker: npc
n5b.sl: Potem bom raje kar tukaj. Je fant ali punca?
n5b.en: Then I'll stay right here. Is he a boy or a girl?
n5b.deliverySL: [warmly] Potem bom raje kar tukaj. Je fant ali punca?

n6.speaker: npc
n6.en: A little boy! And what breed is he?

n7.speaker: npc
n7.sl: Mešanci so najboljši. Oj! Kar name je skočil!
n7.en: Mixed breeds are the best. Oh! He's jumped right up on me!
n7.deliverySL: [cheerfully] Mešanci so najboljši. Oj! Kar name je skočil!

c7a.speaker: client
c7a.en: Sorry! He just wants to play.

n8a.speaker: npc
n8a.sl: Nič hudega! Joj, kako razposajen je, kar ne more biti pri miru!
n8a.en: No harm done! Oh, he's so boisterous, he just can't keep still!
n8a.deliverySL: [excitedly, quickly] Nič hudega! Joj, kako razposajen je, kar ne more biti pri miru!

n8b.speaker: npc
n8b.sl: No, prijazen ali ne, vsa sem blatna. Joj, kako razposajen je, kar ne more biti pri miru!
n8b.en: Well, friendly or not, I'm all muddy. Oh, he's so boisterous, he just can't keep still!
n8b.deliverySL: [businesslike] No, prijazen ali ne, vsa sem blatna. Joj, kako razposajen je, kar ne more biti pri miru!

n10a.speaker: npc
n10a.sl: Razposajen je, zelo živahen. Ne more biti pri miru. A greste tudi vi v park? Lahko gremo skupaj.
n10a.en: He's boisterous, very lively. He can't keep still. Are you going to the park too? We can walk together.
n10a.deliverySL: [warmly] Razposajen je, zelo živahen. Ne more biti pri miru. A greste tudi vi v park? Lahko gremo skupaj.

n10b.speaker: npc
n10b.sl: Joj, kako razposajen je, kar ne more biti pri miru!
n10b.en: Oh, he's so boisterous, he just can't keep still!
n10b.deliverySL: [excitedly, quickly] Joj, kako razposajen je, kar ne more biti pri miru!

n10c.speaker: npc
n10c.sl: Zelo je živahen. Skače, skače, ne more biti pri miru. A greste tudi vi v park? Lahko gremo skupaj.
n10c.en: He's very lively. Jumps and jumps, can't keep still. Are you going to the park too? We can walk together.
n10c.deliverySL: [warmly] Zelo je živahen. Skače, skače, ne more biti pri miru. A greste tudi vi v park? Lahko gremo skupaj.

c12b.speaker: client
c12b.sl: Danes ne, gremo naprej. Adijo, lep dan!
c12b.en: Not today, we're going on. Bye, have a nice day!
c12b.deliverySL: [warmly] Danes ne, gremo naprej. Adijo, lep dan!

nWalk.speaker: npc
nWalk.en: Great, let's go! Come on, Enzo!

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.sl: Seveda, ni problema. Adijo, pa lep sprehod!
nBye.en: Of course, no problem. Bye, and have a nice walk!
nBye.deliverySL: [warmly] Seveda, ni problema. Adijo, pa lep sprehod!

c1x.speaker: client
c1x.sl: Dober dan. Ime mu je Enzo, še mladiček je.
c1x.en: Good day. His name is Enzo, he's still a puppy.
c1x.deliverySL: [warmly] Dober dan. Ime mu je Enzo, še mladiček je.

c3x.speaker: client
c3x.sl: Star je pet mesecev. Ne skrbite, prijazen je.
c3x.en: He's five months old. Don't worry, he's friendly.
c3x.deliverySL: [warmly] Star je pet mesecev. Ne skrbite, prijazen je.

c5xx.speaker: client
c5xx.sl: Fant je. Prijazen je, samo živahen.
c5xx.en: He's a boy. He's friendly, just lively.
c5xx.deliverySL: [warmly] Fant je. Prijazen je, samo živahen.

c6x.speaker: client
c6x.en: He's a mixed breed. You can pet him.

n2pup.speaker: npc
n2pup.sl: Še mladiček? Koliko pa je star?
n2pup.en: Still a puppy? How old is he, then?
n2pup.deliverySL: [warmly] Še mladiček? Koliko pa je star?

n6a.speaker: npc
n6a.sl: Nič hudega, naj kar pride. Kakšne pasme pa je?
n6a.en: It's fine, let him come. What breed is he?
n6a.deliverySL: [warmly] Nič hudega, naj kar pride. Kakšne pasme pa je?

n6b.speaker: npc
n6b.sl: No, potem pa pridi sem, fantek! Kakšne pasme pa je?
n6b.en: Well then, come here, little boy! What breed is he?
n6b.deliverySL: [warmly] No, potem pa pridi sem, fantek! Kakšne pasme pa je?

n7b.speaker: npc
n7b.sl: O, hvala! Oj, kar name je skočil!
n7b.en: Oh, thanks! Whoa, he's jumped right up on me!
n7b.deliverySL: [cheerfully] O, hvala! Oj, kar name je skočil!
